lines.zh: 我贴着海床游，鳍扫过沙。
lines.en: I cruise the seabed, fins brushing the sand.
I am far more at ease in water than on land.

lines.zh: 传说的海很暗，我不用看。
lines.en: The Precasia sea is dark; I do not need to see.
One sweep of my tail moves the whole water.

lines.zh: 长长的海草擦过我的背。
lines.en: Long kelp drags over my back as I pass.
I do not rush; the prey tires first.
Water pressure presses on my bony plates.

lines.zh: 我沿礁石绕了整整一圈。
lines.en: I make one full circuit around the reef.
Bones lie buried in the sand below.
I swim heavy, the way a stone would.
The current carries me, and I let it.
My dark shape touches the seabed first.
The surface is far; only a trace of light remains.
The smell of blood comes from my left.

lines.zh: 我的头骨是一整块，撞什么都硬。
lines.en: My skull is one solid plate; it hits anything hard.

lines.zh: 往上浮一点，光才照到我的甲。
lines.en: A little higher, and the light finally reaches my armor.

lines.zh: 我停在水层里，像块暗礁。
lines.en: I hold in the water column like a hidden reef.

lines.zh: 海床上没有声音，只有流。
lines.en: Nothing on the seabed but the current's hush.

lines.zh: 我把嘴闭上，牙还在外面。
lines.en: I close my mouth; the teeth still show.

lines.zh: 三十五颗心，够我慢慢等。
lines.en: Thirty-five hearts is enough to wait slowly.
Fish hide in the crevices of the reef.

lines.zh: 我让水流过鳃，一下一下。
lines.en: I let the current pass my gills, one beat at a time.
This sea is too quiet; I am a little hungry.
I rest in the dark like a piece of reef.
Something moves upstream, small and quick.
I do not chase fish; the fish come to me.
A thin film of algae grows on my plates.

lines.zh: 深海的日子，一天天一样。
lines.en: Deep-sea days are all the same.
I open my jaws and let water pass through.
I wait for something big enough.
You came down, and you brought a light.
You kick through water like a clumsy visitor.
I swing my body round to face you.

lines.zh: 你的脚在踩水，声音很乱。
lines.en: Your feet kick water in a messy rhythm.

lines.zh: 三十二格内，你已经在名单上。
lines.en: Within thirty-two blocks, you are already on my list.

lines.zh: 我看你的骨甲，比我的薄。
lines.en: Your plating is thinner than mine.
Your lamp does not reach far down here.
Rust and sweat mix in the water around you.
I am not in a hurry; catch your breath.
You are between me and the surface.

lines.zh: 你砍在骨甲上，刀滑开了。
lines.en: Your blade slides off my bony plate.
That was not enough to push me back.
Thirty-five hearts; take your time.
What I bleed is blood, not water.

lines.zh: 水里的伤口会自己收口。
lines.en: Wounds close on their own down here.
Your arrow lost its force in the water.
I gave ground, but I was not knocked back.
Pain only makes my jaws clamp tighter.
The deep sea deals worse wounds than this.
A crack has opened in my plate.
The scent of blood drifts down the current.

lines.zh: 血滴进水里，扩散得很快。
lines.en: Blood hits the water and spreads fast.
Bait? I am far bigger than any fish.
You shake it, and scraps sink toward me.
I am not picky, as long as it is meat.
Bait that small will never fill me.
You back away with the meat still raised.

lines.zh: 味道越来越近，我张嘴了。
lines.en: The smell draws closer; my jaws open.

lines.zh: 你以为用饵就能拉走我？
lines.en: You think bait can lead me away?

lines.zh: 我吃的不是饵，是拿饵的手。
lines.en: I am not eating the bait, but the hand holding it.
You ram me, and I do not give an inch.
My bony plates bounce you away.
That impact moved me half an inch.
The water surges up around us.
You push me like pushing a reef.
One shove from me and you tumble.
My bite has not even started yet.
Sand lifts off the seabed where we struggle.
Do not press against my flank.
I sink, and you float up.

lines.zh: 大我半圈的那条在礁后。
lines.en: The one half a length bigger waits behind the reef.

lines.zh: 我们并行，水被推成两股。
lines.en: We swim abreast, splitting the current in two.
Its jaws close a little harder than mine.
One sea, two big fish.
We circle, stirring the sand.
Old scars line its bony plates.

lines.zh: 传说的海里，我们不常见。
lines.en: In the Precasia sea, we are rarely seen.
It swims ahead; I ride its wake.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴拍出同一节奏。
lines.en: Two tails beat out the same slow rhythm.
We need no call; the water carries it.
No hands on me; the sand keeps what falls.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西，与我无关。
lines.en: Whatever sinks down here is nothing to me.
The iron sank to the seabed; I leave it.
A dropped sword will rust down here.
I use my jaws, never hands, to take things.
What falls in belongs to the sea.
Picking things up would distract me.
I do not collect; I swallow.

lines.zh: 那块盾牌太大了，吞不下。
lines.en: That shield is too big to swallow.
Everything on the seabed belongs to the sand.
Thirty-two blocks: you just crossed the line.
Vibrations in water never lie.
I turn and lock onto your position.
Swim as lightly as you like; the water moves.
A shadow falling from the surface.
That fish is too large to be you.
This moment has been long in coming.
Your bubbles gave you away.

lines.zh: 目标只有一个，不会认错。
lines.en: One target only, and I will not mistake it.
I drop lower, aiming beneath you.
I am below you, closing slowly.
You swim up; I follow upward.
I judge distance in water very well.
You look back, and I am already nearer.
The kelp does not block my sight.

lines.zh: 我按直线走，你绕也没用。
lines.en: I take the straight line; your circling will not help.
Your legs are kicking slower now.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床，避开你的灯。
lines.en: I hug the seabed, out of your lamp's reach.
Over the final stretch, I pick up speed.
You are at the reef, where the way narrows.
My jaws close, and the water is shoved aside.
This bite lands for seven; stop struggling.

lines.zh: 骨板碰骨板的声音很闷。
lines.en: Bone plate meets bone plate with a dull sound.
Once my jaws take you, you cannot move.
I bite the leg, not the shield.
Blood spills, and the sea will know.
You thrashed twice; I did not let go.
That bite cost you your weapon.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿本就是骨板边缘。
lines.en: My teeth are the edges of bony plates.
One more bite, and you sink.

lines.zh: 传说的海很宽，我很少来。
lines.en: The Precasia sea is wide; I rarely come.
A shape in the deep water grows larger.

lines.zh: 我从海床的暗处升起来。
lines.en: I rise from the dark part of the seabed.
I am alone in this stretch of water.
The current changed because I arrived.
The fish scatter first; then I appear.
My shadow covers the reef.

lines.zh: 传说的海水很凉，正合适。
lines.en: The Precasia water is cold, and that suits me.
From the shore you will not see me.

lines.zh: 海面起了一阵不该有的浪。
lines.en: A wave rises on the surface that should not be there.
Fire underwater is only white light.
I land on dry sand, gills gaping.
Drowning in water, how absurd that is.
The blast shoves me half a block, no more.

lines.zh: 箭扎在骨缝里，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrow is wedged between my plates.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的鳃一阵发紧。
lines.en: Magic makes my gills clench shut.
This sea has emptied, and I have not fed.

lines.zh: 雷进水，整片海亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and the sea flashes.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我沉不下去。
lines.en: No water here, and I cannot sink.
